news.title: Audi defends plans for a $4 billion Georgia plant amid VW restructuring, tariffs
news.description: Audi's CEO defended the company's plans for a $4 billion plant in Georgia, calling it a business decision to grow sales and reduce exposure to U.S. tariffs.

news.title: Ukraine disputes Elon Musk’s claim that its military violated Starlink terms during drone operations
news.description: Ukraine challenged Musk’s claim that its military violated Starlink terms, arguing that commercial Starlink limits prevented medium- and long-range strike use.

news.title: What Democrats and Republicans fear most about each other: CNBC survey has the answers
news.description: The economy is still a key issue in the 2026 election, but voters are concerned about Trump testing the bounds of the office and Democratic Socialist polices.
